330133359.eligibility: California 501(c)(3) public charities, national organizations working in California, and California state or local government entities. Small volunteer-led groups are funded only through the flexible funding program.
330133359.geographic_limits: California only (statewide, including rural, unincorporated and Tribal communities); national organizations need a California footprint.
330133359.grant_range_stated: Typically $50,000 to $100,000 per year for strategy grants; capacity building grants up to $50,000.
330133359.how_to_apply: Core grants: no application; email archstone@archstone.org to ask for a meeting. Capacity building: when a round opens, complete the screening quiz, then apply in the online grant portal (mail and email requests are not accepted).
330133359.name: Archstone Foundation
330133359.not_funded: Capital campaigns; individuals; biomedical research; political campaigns, voter registration drives, lobbying for specific legislation; organizations that discriminate. Capacity building grants do not cover routine operating costs or ongoing programs.
330133359.notes: California-only funder; not a fit for an aging-services client outside California. New strategy rolled out 2025-2026. Earlier capacity building rounds (2023, 2024) opened with an LOI in July-August; the 2025 round used a short screening questionnaire in July. Applicants typically outnumber grants five to ten times. Unfunded full-proposal applicants have received a small award.
330133359.page_dated: 2026 FAQ; site footer copyright 2026; capacity building page still shows the July 2025 window.
